newsitem.title: SPAIN: Doctors believe Spain kidnap victim will die soon.
newsitem.headline: Doctors believe Spain kidnap victim will die soon.

text.p: Doctors in Spain said on Saturday a kidnapped politician who was shot in the head by ETA Basque guerrillas was not likely to survive for long.
"The most logical thing is that this man dies in the next few hours, or what could occur is brain death," a hospital spokesman told a news conference.

Miguel Angel Blanco, a 29-year-old Basque town councillor, was found bleeding and with his hands tied on Saturday afternoon in a wooded area near the northern coastal city of San Sebastian. He was rushed to a local hospital. Doctors said he was in a coma with two bullets lodged in his brain.
A hospital spokesman said Blanco was in an "extremely grave condition" and that doctors had detected "fluids compatible with brain death".
One doctor said Blanco had suffered "irreversible" brain damage.
"Medical science can be wrong," the spokesman said. "We would very much like to be wrong. But what we don't like to do is keep the door open to hope when the situation is complicated like this."
